name: Solid Waste Engineering and Management
description: Different types of solid waste: origin, analysis, composition and characterization. Integrated solid waste management system. Municipal solid wWaste (MSW): collection, storage, segregation, reuse and recycling possibilities, transportation, treatment and processing techniques and final disposal. Management of: biomedical, radioactive, electronic, plastic, construction and demolition and industrial solid wastes, rules and regulations, case studies of different cities.
